judgement.reason: LobeHub is a single Next.js web app using PostgreSQL, Redis and S3, so the outcome with changes is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:7-alpine) in docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is Redis, which Deployz provides as managed single-node Redis, and the app connects to it through REDIS_URL.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume fts-search-reindex-state:/app/.elasticsearch-reindex (docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml lobe)
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the Elasticsearch reindex state directory can be lost on every restart without harm, so the finding stands until you confirm it.
